fields.title: Synthetic Graph Study 08: Graph Partitions for Synthetic Document Collections
fields.abstractNote: Synthetic study 08 examining graph partitions over synthetic document collections. All inputs, outputs, and evaluations in this document are synthetic and generated for offline end-to-end testing only.

evidence.reason: Synthetic registry record resolves the same DOI and reports the same title, venue, volume, issue, pages and publication date as the input record.
Synthetic publisher page lists the same article title, the same author, the same journal title with abbreviation, and the same volume, issue and page range.
Synthetic index record independently confirms the DOI, the publication date, the page range and the English language of the direct work.
